name: English
notes: Keys are the original Italian text and must not be changed: translate only the values. Empty or missing values fall back to English. Placeholders such as {0} must be kept. "messages" are interface texts, "terms" are default names and demo data for new organizations, "plurals" are counts (zero, one, two, few, many, other).

messages.Troppi tag: riduci il catalogo prima di: Too many tags: reduce the catalog before importing.
messages.Seleziona uno o più tag. Gestiscili in I: Select one or more tags. Manage them in Settings › Tags.
messages.Nessun tag disponibile. Aggiungili in Im: No tags available. Add them in Settings › Tags.
messages.Nessun tag: aggiungine uno per classific: No tags: add one to categorize tasks.
messages.Crea i tag di questa organizzazione, sce: Create this organization's tags, choose names and colors, and set their display order. Each task can have multiple tags.
messages.Massimo {0} tag, con nomi univoci di mas: Up to {0} tags, with unique names of up to {1} characters.
You can define up to {0} tags.
messages.Eliminando un tag e salvando, viene rimo: Deleting a tag and saving removes it from tasks using it, including hidden tasks. Tasks and other tags are not deleted.
messages.Lingua, link al portale, nomi delle tab,: Language, portal link, tab names, hours per day, text sizes, statuses, urgencies, highlighters, tags and list columns. Replaces current settings.
messages.Tutte le attività, una direzione. Pianif: All tasks, one direction. Plan your work and focus on upcoming releases.
messages.Collega il lavoro alla sua origine. Più: Connect work to its origin. Multiple incidents can share the same problem.
messages.Ogni release è una tappa. Le date e le a: Every release is a milestone. Dates and tasks stay automatically aligned.
messages.Una vista di sola lettura, sempre alline: A read-only view, always aligned with your tasks. One space for every status.
messages.Nomi, flussi e colori. Configura il tuo: Names, workflows and colors. Configure your workspace and take it anywhere.
messages.Nessun cloud. Nessun account. Tutto sott: No cloud. No account. Everything under control.
messages.Un salvataggio è già in corso. Riprova t: A save is in progress. Please try again in a moment.
messages.Maiusc + clic su una colonna per ordinar: Shift + click a column for multi-column sorting
messages.Clic per ordinare; Maiusc+clic per ordin: Click to sort; Shift+click for multi-column sorting
One archive, four perspectives. Issues, milestones and kanban update automatically.
messages.Nessuna attività trovata. Crea una nuova: No tasks found. Create a new task or change the filters.
messages.Link generato dal modello dell’organizza: Link generated from the organization template
messages.Inserisci il codice portale per generare: Enter the portal code to generate the link.
messages.Nessun link: imposta il modello del link: No link: set the link template in the organization settings or enter a specific link.
messages.Il link di ogni attività viene costruito: Each task link is built from its portal code: enter this organization’s portal address and put the {code} placeholder where the code must appear.
messages.Esempi: https://jira.azienda.com/browse/: Examples: https://jira.company.com/browse/{code} or https://portal.net/{code}/details. If missing, https:// is added automatically. Leave empty to generate no links. A specific link entered in a task takes precedence.
messages.Nessun modello: i link vengono creati so: No template: links exist only when entered in the individual task.
messages.Aggiungi il segnaposto {codice} nel punt: Add the {code} placeholder where the portal code must be inserted.
messages.Indirizzo non valido: usa un indirizzo w: Invalid address: use a web address, for example https://jira.company.com/browse/{code}.
messages.Il modello del link portale deve essere: The portal link template must be a valid web address containing {code}.
messages.Nascondi solo dalla lista attività (rest: Hide from the task list only (still visible in milestones and kanban)
messages.sarà eliminata definitivamente. Le assoc: will be permanently deleted. Issue associations will remain available.
messages.Incident e problem vengono riportati aut: Incidents and problems are automatically linked to tasks with the same portal code, regardless of letter case.
messages.Nessuna associazione. Aggiungi un codice: No associations. Add a portal code with an incident and/or problem.
messages.Specificare almeno un incident o un prob: Specify at least an incident or a problem. Codes can be reused across associations.
messages.I relativi incident e problem non appari: The associated incidents and problems will no longer appear on tasks unless other associations exist.
messages.Aggiungi attività e release date per cos: Add tasks and release dates to build your roadmap.
messages.Scorri in orizzontale per esplorare le r: Scroll horizontally to explore releases and vertically to see all tasks. The same date has the same color in every view.
messages.Per modificare uno stato usa la lista at: To change a status, use the task list. Configure column order in settings.
messages.Modifica la visualizzazione in giorni. L: Changes the display in days. Previously recorded hours stay the same.
Choose a palette or create your own.
At least one option must remain.
messages.Questa opzione è usata da alcune attivit: This option is used by tasks, including hidden ones. Reassign them before deleting it.
At least one theme must remain.
messages.Carica un’immagine: sfondo, superfici, t: Upload an image: background, surfaces, text and accent are extracted and assigned automatically. You can then adjust them with the color controls. Transparency is shown on white.
messages.Ritocco facoltativo: colore da prelevare: Optional adjustment: color to sample with a click
messages.L’immagine resta locale e non viene salv: The image stays local and is not saved: only colors are stored in the theme.
messages.Anteprima dal vivo: il tema viene applic: Live preview: the theme is applied to the app immediately. Save settings to keep it, otherwise the previous one remains.
messages.Le modifiche, inclusi tema e dimensioni: Changes, including the previewed theme and text sizes, take effect only when you save. If you leave without saving, the previous configuration remains.
messages.L’immagine contiene pochi colori distint: The image has few distinct colors: some roles share the same color.
messages.Immagine usata per generare automaticame: Image used to automatically generate the four theme colors
messages.Scegli un’immagine PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP image.
messages.L’immagine è troppo grande. Il limite è: The image is too large. The limit is 15 MB.
messages.Impossibile leggere l’immagine. Il file: Cannot read this image. The file may be damaged or unsupported.
messages.Il selettore immagine non è disponibile: The image picker is unavailable on this device.
messages.Impossibile estrarre la palette dall’imm: Cannot extract a palette from this image.
messages.Archivio JSON locale e copia automatica: Local JSON archive with an automatic copy of the previous save.
messages.Per condividere l’app chiudila e copia l: To share the app, close it and copy the executable together with the data folder. Do not run copies using the same data folder at the same time.
messages.Tutte le attività e le associazioni issu: All tasks and issue associations in this organization will be deleted. Themes and settings will stay unchanged. Export a backup first to keep them.
messages.Tutte le impostazioni qui sotto si appli: All settings below apply only to the selected organization.
messages.Scegli il logo durante la creazione: ver: Choose a logo during creation: it will be stored with the organization and automatically generate its theme.
messages.Logo pronto: il tema verrà applicato all: Logo ready: the theme will be applied to the new organization.
messages.Verranno eliminati tutti i suoi dati, il: All its data, logo and settings will be deleted. Other organizations will not be changed. Export a backup first.
At least one organization must remain.
messages.Dati e impostazioni sono separati per or: Data and settings are isolated per organization. Your selection is saved automatically.
messages.Hai modifiche non salvate. Puoi salvarle: You have unsaved changes. Save or discard them before switching organization.
messages.Il logo e il tema vengono conservati sol: The logo and theme belong only to this organization and travel with the archive.
messages.Logo caricato e tema generato in antepri: Logo loaded and theme previewed. Save settings to keep them.
messages.L’immagine del logo è troppo grande dopo: The logo image is too large after conversion.
messages.La lingua è salvata per questa organizza: Language is saved per organization. Custom names and content are not translated.
messages.Questo file è un’esportazione di organiz: This file is an organization export (themes, settings or data): use “Import from file…” in the “Export and import organization” section.
messages.Le ore per giorno devono essere comprese: Hours per day must be greater than 0 and no more than 24.
messages.Indicare codice e almeno un incident o p: Enter a portal code and at least one incident or problem.
messages.Il progressivo deve essere un intero non: Sequence must be a non-negative integer.
messages.Il link deve iniziare con http:// o http: The link must start with http:// or https://.
messages.Verifica i permessi di scrittura della c: Check folder write permissions and preserve the existing archive before making changes.
messages.Avvia l’app con OrbitKanban-Portable.exe: Start the app using OrbitKanban-Portable.exe or npm start, not by opening the HTML file directly.
messages.Mentre OrbitKanban è aperto puoi lavorar: While OrbitKanban is open you can also work from a browser on this PC, with different organizations in separate tabs. Changes sync in real time between the app and the tabs.
messages.Raggiungibile solo da questo computer (1: Reachable only from this computer (127.0.0.1) and protected by a personal key: the access link contains the key, do not share it. Closing the app disconnects the browser tabs.
messages.Stai usando OrbitKanban dal browser: l’a: You are using OrbitKanban from the browser: the app on the PC must stay open. Each tab can show a different organization.
Access link copied to the clipboard.
messages.Organizzazione aperta nel browser predef: Organization opened in the default browser.
messages.OrbitKanban non è raggiungibile: riapri: OrbitKanban is not reachable: reopen the app on the PC and reload the page.
messages.L’organizzazione aperta è stata eliminat: The open organization was deleted in another window. You are now viewing another organization.
messages.Dati aggiornati da un’altra finestra. Le: Data updated from another window. Your unsaved settings are kept: saving them will take precedence.
messages.Milestone ogni due settimane da gennaio: Biweekly milestones since January 2025 with sample tasks, issues, notes and hidden rows.
messages.Salva temi, configurazione e dati di que: Save this organization’s themes, settings and data as separate files, to share them or import them again here or into another copy of OrbitKanban.
messages.Temi, configurazione e dati in un unico: Themes, settings and data in a single file
messages.Scegli un file esportato da OrbitKanban:: Choose a file exported by OrbitKanban: before applying it you can decide which parts to import and where.
messages.File troppo grande per un’esportazione O: This file is too large to be an OrbitKanban export.
messages.Hai modifiche non salvate: esportazione: You have unsaved changes: export and import use the saved settings. Save or discard them before continuing.
messages.quelli con lo stesso identificativo veng: those with the same identifier are updated, the others are added.
messages.Lingua, link al portale, nomi delle tab,: Language, portal link, tab names, hours per day, statuses and urgencies. Replaces the current settings.
Language, portal link, tab names, hours per day, text sizes, statuses and urgencies. Replaces the current settings.
messages.Le attività con lo stesso identificativo: Tasks with the same identifier are updated, issues already present are not duplicated.
messages.Attività e issue attuali vengono sostitu: Current tasks and issues are replaced by those in the file.
messages.L’organizzazione attuale non viene modif: The current organization is left unchanged.
messages.Verrà creata una nuova organizzazione co: A new organization will be created with the selected parts: the current one is left unchanged.
messages.La configurazione attuale verrà sostitui: The current settings will be replaced: existing tasks are kept and mapped to the file’s statuses and urgencies with the same name, otherwise to the same position.
messages.Stati e urgenze delle attività importate: Statuses and urgencies of the imported tasks are mapped to this organization’s ones with the same name, otherwise to the same position.
messages.Tutte le attività e le issue attuali di: All current tasks and issues of this organization will be deleted and replaced by those in the file.
messages.Se vuoi poter tornare indietro, esporta: To be able to go back, first export a backup or the full organization.
messages.Il file selezionato non è un file JSON v: The selected file is not a valid JSON file.
messages.Il file non è un’esportazione di organiz: The file is not an OrbitKanban organization export.
messages.Questo file è un backup completo dell’ar: This file is a full archive backup: use “Import backup” in the “Data that travels with you” section.
messages.Il file è stato creato da una versione p: The file was created by a newer version of OrbitKanban: update the app to import it.
The file does not contain themes.

messages.Barra superiore, pulsanti, statistiche,: Top bar, buttons, statistics, filters, settings and messages.
messages.Organizzazione, viste e informazioni nel: Organization, views and details in the left column.
messages.Occhiello, titolo e descrizione in cima: Eyebrow, title and description at the top of each view.
messages.Righe e colonne della lista attività e d: Rows and columns of the task list and linked issues.
messages.Modifica di attività e issue, conferme e: Task and issue editing, confirmations and import.
messages.Regola il testo di ogni parte dell’app:: Adjust the text of each part of the app: the preview applies instantly across the whole interface, save to keep it. Minimums and maximums keep everything readable and tidy.
messages.100% è la dimensione consigliata; le pre: 100% is the recommended size; presets adjust every part at once.
messages.Ogni parte ha un minimo e un massimo, a: Each part has a minimum and a maximum, in 5% steps: the interface always stays usable.
messages.Le dimensioni valgono solo per questa or: Sizes apply only to this organization and are included in the settings export.
messages.Esempio: prepara il rilascio e aggiorna: Example: prepare the release and update the documentation.
messages.I dati sono stati modificati da un’altra: The data was changed in another window. Reload before saving.
messages.Sostituire tutte le organizzazioni, i da: Replace all organizations, data and settings?
messages.Il precedente archivio sarà conservato i: The previous archive will be kept in workspace.json.bak.
messages.La chiave di accesso non è corretta. Apr: The access key is not valid. Open the browser from the “Open in browser” button in the OrbitKanban app.
messages.Sessione browser non autorizzata. Riapri: Browser session not authorized. Reopen the link from the app.
messages.Per aprire OrbitKanban nel browser usa i: To open OrbitKanban in the browser use the “Open in browser” button in the app, or copy the access link from Settings.
messages.Il file selezionato non è un archivio JS: The selected file is not a valid JSON archive.
messages.Scegli la lingua di questa organizzazion: Choose the language of this organization. Translations are plain JSON files: you can add more without changing the app.
messages.Apri la cartella lingue: contiene en.tem: Open the languages folder: it contains en.template.json, the complete English file to use as a template.
messages.Copialo con il codice della nuova lingua: Copy it using the code of the new language, for example de.json, and update code, name and locale.
messages.Traduci solo i valori a destra: le chiav: Translate only the values on the right: the keys on the left are the original text and must not be changed. Missing texts stay in English.
messages.Premi “Ricarica lingue”: la nuova lingua: Press “Reload languages”: the new language will appear in the list.
messages.Questa lingua non è installata su questo: This language is not installed on this PC: texts are shown in English.
The file is not an OrbitKanban language.
messages.Il codice lingua deve coincidere con il: The language code must match the file name.

messages.Gomma attiva: clicca sulle righe per tog: Eraser active: click rows to remove their highlight. Press Esc to finish.
messages.Evidenziatore «{0}» attivo: clicca sulle: Highlighter “{0}” active: click rows to color them, click again to remove the color. Press Esc to finish.
messages.Scegli un colore e clicca sulle righe da: Pick a color and click the rows to highlight, or use the ● dot at the end of each row.
messages.Nessun colore disponibile: aggiungili ne: No colors available: add them in the settings.
messages.Scegli quali colonne mostrare e in che o: Choose which columns to show and in what order
messages.Deve restare visibile almeno una colonna: At least one column must stay visible.
messages.Spunta le colonne da mostrare e trascina: Tick the columns to show and drag them (or use the arrows) to change their order. Hiding a column does not delete any data.
messages.Trascina per riordinare, oppure usa i ta: Drag to reorder, or use the ↑ ↓ keys
messages.Colora la riga nella lista attività. I c: Colors the row in the task list. Colors are managed in Settings › Highlighters.
messages.L’ordine qui diventa l’ordine del kanban: This order becomes the kanban order. Turn on ★ to automatically highlight every row with that status; to color single rows use the Highlighters.
messages.Colori per evidenziare singole righe del: Colors to highlight single rows of the task list, regardless of their status. In the list use the Highlighter bar above the table, the ● dot at the end of each row or the Highlight field of the task form.
messages.Eliminando un colore, le righe che lo us: Deleting a color removes the highlight from the rows that use it. This order is also used to sort the Highlight column.
messages.Scegli quali colonne mostrare nella list: Choose which columns the task list shows and in what order. Hiding a column does not delete any data. You can also do this with the “Columns” button above the table.
You can define at most {0} colors.
messages.Nessun colore: aggiungine uno per usare: No colors yet: add one to use the highlighter.
